title: The Fallen Heart Flame Wakes
summary: The Fallen Heart Flame, 14th on the Heavenly Flames Ranking, breaks its seal again, and it has formed a body with a mind of its own. Han Feng holds his allies back until the elders and the flame wear each other out, and plans to take Xiao Yan's flame later; Yao Lao warns Xiao Yan not to face Han Feng until he is a Dou Wang. The flame goes after Han Feng to eat his Heavenly Flame, the injured Fan Lao leaves, and Han Feng promises the rest double pills and fights back with Sky Cold Air. Mr. Jin and Mr. Yin back off, and the flame hides among ordinary flames and turns on Xiao Yan. Guided by Yao Lao, Xiao Yan finds its hidden core and strikes it, forcing it into its true form. As he moves to seize it, Han Feng's allies hold off Su Qian, who vows to teach the Black-Corner Region a lesson.

cultivation: Han Feng judges Xiao Yan to be as strong as a Five-Star Dou Huang with borrowed power. Han Feng hopes a second Heavenly Flame will take him from Dou Huang to Dou Zong.
